name: generic
fieldSelector: textarea, input[type=text], input[type=url], input[type=email], input[type=tel], input:not([type]), [contenteditable=true]
skipSelector: input[type=hidden], input[type=submit], input[type=button], input[type=checkbox], input[type=radio], input[type=file], input[type=password], [readonly], [disabled], [aria-hidden=true]
notes: No host is allowed by default. Pass --allow-host <hostname> to authorize one explicitly for this run. This is deliberate: a generic target with a wildcard host would let a mistyped command type into any tab you have open.
